command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
export LC_ALL=C
echo "== verify staged BAM against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' 6949939b5937046f1ec7fdcc764dc47df5dd3c35d48b5487470ae3527d21b04a region.bam > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== picard MarkDuplicates -- deterministic on a fixed coordinate-sorted BAM =="
# LC_ALL=C silences a harmless picard-wrapper locale warning; VERBOSITY=ERROR keeps the log clean.
picard MarkDuplicates I=region.bam O=marked.bam M=dup_metrics.txt QUIET=true VERBOSITY=ERROR 2> md.log
# Never rm the staged region.bam (sticky /tmp -> EPERM under a different user, which rm -f
# does not suppress). marked.bam is ours; we don't stage it out (the metrics are the evidence).

# ---- smoke check (inside the task) ----
# The single LIBRARY data line: cols 2=UNPAIRED_READS_EXAMINED 3=READ_PAIRS_EXAMINED
# 6=UNPAIRED_READ_DUPLICATES 7=READ_PAIR_DUPLICATES 9=PERCENT_DUPLICATION.
read UPE RPE UPD RPD PCT < <(awk 'p{print $2,$3,$6,$7,$9; exit} /^LIBRARY\t/{p=1}' dup_metrics.txt)
{
  echo "read_pairs_examined     $RPE  want 52189   (fixed 30x chr20:2.0-2.4Mb BAM)"
  echo "unpaired_reads_examined $UPE  want 122"
  echo "read_pair_duplicates    $RPD  want 5012    (exact-or-wrong: MarkDuplicates is deterministic)"
  echo "unpaired_read_dups      $UPD  want 25"
  echo "percent_duplication     $PCT  want 0.096163"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$RPE" -eq 52189
test "$UPE" -eq 122
test "$RPD" -eq 5012
test "$UPD" -eq 25
test "$PCT" = "0.096163"
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
